utterance: Our VPC `windomain-vpc` (192.168.0.0/16) already exists but still runs on the region's default DHCP settings. Give it a custom DHCP options set: domain name `windomain.local`, name servers combining our own DNS server 192.168.56.102 with Google's public DNS 8.8.8.8, and a NetBIOS name server at 192.168.56.102. Associate that options set with the VPC so the VPC uses these DHCP settings.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: the pre-existing VPC 192.168.0.0/16 (Name windomain-vpc) is associated with a DHCP options set that carries the domain name windomain.local, name servers combining the custom resolver 192.168.56.102 with Google's public DNS 8.8.8.8, and 192.168.56.102 as its NetBIOS name server
